newsitem.title: UK: UK parliament will dissolve April 8 - official.
newsitem.headline: UK parliament will dissolve April 8 - official.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major announced a May 1 date for national elections and his office gave the following further details;-
Parliament will be prorogued on Friday March 21 and dissolved on Tuesday April 8.

The general election will take place on Thursday May 1. The new parliament will be summoned to meet on Wednesday May 7 when the first business will be the election of the Speaker and the swearing in of members. The State Opening will be on Wednesday May 14.
